title: Can I BEAT Infinite Chess? (vs @TwoNiche )
summary: The creator plays a best-of-three match of Infinite Chess (infinitechess.org-style: the board extends infinitely in every direction) against chess YouTuber TwoNiche, with ~5-minute clocks. Sliding pieces (queen, rooks, bishops) can fly far outside the initial 8x8 area and attack from distant ranks/files, while knights are slow and used for defence around the king. Game 1 is drawn (half point each), he wins games 2 and 3 (the last with 'the most devious checkmate').
rules: Board is unbounded in all directions; there are no edges - pieces can move any distance off the starting area.
Standard piece movement; sliders can travel arbitrarily far ('the bishop comes... where is that bishop?').
Kings can leave/enter the original area freely.
